meta.title: BuildCostGH — Automated Content Plan (rolling 12 months)
meta.description: Deterministic, adjustable 1-year content calendar. Edit this file, commit, and the Content Planner on the next cron run generates the upcoming slots exactly as specified. Topics rotate round-robin through each pillar's pool; rejected drafts don't block future slots.

schedule.formatHint: Regional cost insight: anchor on the published region-rate database (cheapest vs priciest region today), tie to a real location, end with a click to /costs or /calculator.
Cost comparison post: X vs Y (storey vs single, build vs buy, roofing systems, flooring options). One clear winner for the reader's budget, honest trade-offs.
Diaspora / financing / crypto post: paying from abroad, MTN MoMo vs cards vs crypto (USDC/USDT/ETH/BTC via Coinbase Commerce), exchange-rate reality for budgeting a build.
Materials / community post: cement-sand-steel prices, bulk buying, seasonal price moves, a savings tip, or a builder community question. Conversational, shares well.

Long-form SEO blog post built around the slot keyword: structured sections, a real cost table or range, FAQ-style closing, and a promo caption snippet. Body becomes the blog draft; caption is the social promo.
